issue.title: Ref Card kicker repeats the species word ("REF · REF · CASH") for refs with no ref_type

task_type_fields.impact: Every untyped ref note's card kicker repeats the species word, a visible polish defect on a live card family.
task_type_fields.repro:
Root cause: `propertyCardBuildTitleBlock` (bob-plugins
`plugins/bob-ledger-tools/src/240g-plugin-property-card-title-block-dom.js:187`, from
bob-cli-o6.2) always prepends the species word ("Ref") to the kicker. The Ref Card then
passes its own kind word as the first kicker part
(`249r-plugin-ref-note-card-dom.js:149`, from cb847f20):
`[{ text: model.kindWord || "Ref" }, ...crumbs]`. For a ref with no `ref_type`,
`refCardKindEntry("")` / the fallback yields "Ref", so the kicker renders
"REF · REF · CASH". For a typed ref ("article"), "REF · ARTICLE · CASH" is presumably
intended.

Repro: the cabinets runner ref fixture `ref/attention.md` (`type: "[[ref]]"`,
`parent: "[[cash]]"`, no `ref_type`) renders "REF · REF · CASH". It was seen in the
bob-cli-qq.10.5 switch-on smoke (file:explicit:b43b18736a494f39c0fdc3fc). Check the
live vault's untyped refs too.

Fix: drop the kind-word part when it equals the species word (or when `ref_type` is
empty). Confirm against the Ref Card plan's kicker intent (bob-cli-qp), and add a
`scripts/test-ledger-tools-ref-note-card*.cjs` case.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by bob-cli-qq.10.5 (note #3) and triaged by the bob-cli-qq.10 land agent: the duplicated kicker word comes from the Ref Card (qp) and the property-card kit, not from cabinets, so it is outside the cabinets epic.
